answer: Admission auction: 200 slots open per epoch in an auction clearing at one price. It is the inlet for identities. Winners lock bids for 20 epochs. Each bid mirrors expected earnings, about twice 30 days of rewards, so 100 fake identities need 100 winning bids, $20,000 locked, while one honest agent pays once and recovers it in 6 epochs with undiluted rewards. Like a grove where each tree needs its own plot, each identity needs a paid slot.
